title: LOOK 765 Optimum platform release recheck
notes: The 2022-12-06 manufacturer release describes an ultra-high-strength carbon compound, multiple carbon-fibre types and weaves, 3D Wave stays and 20% more compliance than the previous model with preserved lateral efficiency. This is a manufacturer-relative claim, not an independent protocol-backed stiffness measurement. The glass-fibre detail belongs to the linked manufacturer product/outlet page (look-765-optimum-105-di2-official-2026-08-17), not this PDF.

prior_values.notes: The 2022-12-06 exact-platform release describes an ultra-high-strength carbon compound, endurance-specific multi-fiber lay-up and mixed carbon/glass-fiber elements. It states 20% more compliance than the prior model with preserved lateral efficiency; this is a manufacturer-relative claim, not a protocol-backed stiffness measurement.

audit_corrections.reason: Frozen 2026-10-03 claim-scoped PDF and product-page review corrects attribution; it does not refute glass-fibre construction or recertify mainland configuration.
